การกำหนดเส้นทางต่อแอป

One desktop-id or package per line with allow, deny, or vpn. Stored under ~/.config/telos/app-routing.txt. On Linux, deny blocks launch in the Telos launcher and vpn sets TELOS_APP_ROUTE=vpn (best-effort, no fake netns). Process-level nftables owner/cgroup routing is not applied, so the session kill-switch stays intact.
ตารางเส้นทาง
ตัวกรอง DNS

Block and allow lists are stored under vault ~/.config/telos/ (dns-block.txt, dns-allow.txt). A NextDNS configuration ID applies DoT via resolvectl on Linux when available. Enable Telos DNS stub (or set dns-stub.port) to run a local 127.0.0.1 forwarder that NXDOMAINs blocked hosts and redirect DNS with nftables — then host lists become Enforced. If the stub cannot bind or nft fails, status stays Failed/PreferenceOnly. Windows and macOS store preferences only.

Telos DNS stub listens on 127.0.0.1 (default port 5353), answers NXDOMAIN for dns-block.txt (allowlist wins), and forwards other queries. nftables inet telos_dns redirects outbound port 53 when privileged apply succeeds.
